---
name: Hardware integration report
about: Record bench test results, electrical measurements, or breadboard verification
title: "[HARDWARE] "
labels: hardware, verification
assignees: ''
---

**Hardware Subsystem**
- Component: [e.g. HC-SR04 ultrasonic, IR flame LM393, SSD1306 OLED, Piezo buzzer]
- Microcontroller Pin: [e.g. D2/D3, A0/D9, A4/A5, D6]
- Measured Supply Voltage: [e.g. 5.02 V DC]

**Maturity Stage**
- [ ] Stage 4: Hardware bench tested (Isolated module on breadboard)
- [ ] Stage 5: Hardware integrated (Connected to system bus)
- [ ] Stage 6: Integrated prototype tested (Full workspace test matrix exercised)

**Test Setup & Procedure**
Describe the bench configuration, stimulus source, and wiring harness.

**Measurement Results & Telemetry**
Provide oscilloscope captures, multimeter readings, or serial output logs.

**Hysteresis & Boundary Observations**
Record observed trip points vs recovery points.
